Overview

  • Date: 31st October 2026 (Saturday).
  • Registrations: Now Open.
  • Kickoff Session: 31st October 2026 (Saturday).

This is a one-day, hands-on hackathon for individuals who want to build and launch a working AI product.

What You’ll Do

During the hackathon, participants will conceptualize, build, and demonstrate an agentic AI solution to a practical, real-world challenge.

You’ll work through the complete product development process:

  • Identify the problem..
  • Design the system architecture..
  • Integrate tools and APIs..
  • Build and demonstrate a functional end product..

The core focus is on building AI agents that can:

  • Reason and make decisions..
  • Interact with tools..
  • Execute tasks independently..

By the end of the day, you’ll have a working prototype that you can add to your portfolio, demonstrate in interviews, and develop further for real-world use.

Participation Guidelines

  • Join individually or in a team. Teams of up to two members are recommended..
  • All development must take place within the hackathon timeframe on 31st October 2026..
  • You may use AI tools, APIs, and frameworks..
  • Clearly document your process, including the problem, solution, and architecture..
  • A functional prototype or live demo is required..

Submission Requirements

Submit the following before the announced deadline on 31st October 2026:

  • A demo video or access to a live working product..
  • Access to the codebase through GitHub or an equivalent platform..
  • A brief explanation of your solution..

Rules

  • Fully pre-built solutions are not allowed. Starter templates are acceptable..
  • Copying or plagiarism will result in disqualification..
  • Clearly distinguish your contribution from AI-generated output..
  • Submissions must demonstrate working functionality. Designs or presentations alone will not qualify..
  • All entries must be submitted before the deadline..

Click here to join the WhatsApp Group for more details: https://chat.whatsapp.com/BUvjhcDWHo3HrPEWdkbNQU?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4&iam=2
